description: This file contains code for configuring PLL (Phase-Locked Loop) settings on an ARM1136 CPU, including data structures, configuration arrays, and functions to set PLL parameters.

methods.name: plla_configure
methods.description: Configures the PLL with specified parameters and manages hardware register settings.

methods.name: plla_set_config
methods.description: Sets the PLL to a specified MHz frequency by selecting the appropriate configuration.
